cause: The existing CI-only network prompt helper accepted only the former CF/QQ application names. The new applications stayed behind UserNotificationCenter with active=false and Bonjour registering.
packageVerification: All three original ZIP/DMG and copied installed file sets/signatures passed on the native Intel runner.
initialGameObservation: All three Canvas snapshots had frames/pollCount advancing and no JS errors; no gameplay/visual success is claimed because the initialization gate never became foreground-active.
fixScope: Read the current verified installed Info.plist exact app names; accept only that app or Python network prompts on disposable GitHub macOS runners. No global permissions disable, game state writes, app recompilation or graphics waiver.
helperNotPackaged: macos-build.py copies Web assets, notices, Info.plist, icon and compiled Sources/*.swift into the app. shared/macos/tools/allow-local-network.py is executed only by the QA verifier.
